description: This file defines the class `reqSpecCommands`, which manages requirements specifications within the TestLink project. It includes methods for creating, editing, updating, copying, deleting, reordering, and managing requirements specifications, as well as handling revisions, file uploads, and bulk monitoring operations.

classes.name: reqSpecCommands
classes.description: Manages requirements specification operations including creation, editing, copying, deleting, reordering, revision handling, file management, and bulk monitoring within the TestLink project.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing database connection, requirement managers, and project-specific settings.

methods.name: setAuditContext
methods.description: Sets the audit context for logging purposes.

methods.name: getReqMgrSystem
methods.description: Returns the linked requirement manager system object.

methods.name: initGuiBean
methods.description: Initializes and returns a GUI object with default properties for rendering views.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Prepares GUI data for creating a new requirement specification.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Prepares GUI data for editing an existing requirement specification.

methods.name: doCreate
methods.description: Handles the creation of a new requirement specification, including status updates and linking custom fields.

methods.name: doUpdate
methods.description: Handles the updating of an existing requirement specification, including revision processing.

methods.name: doDelete
methods.description: Deletes a requirement specification and logs the event.

methods.name: reorder
methods.description: Prepares GUI data to reorder requirement specifications.

methods.name: doReorder
methods.description: Performs the reordering of requirement specifications based on user input.

methods.name: createChild
methods.description: Prepares GUI data for creating a child requirement specification under a parent.

methods.name: copyRequirements
methods.description: Prepares GUI data for copying multiple requirements from one specification.

methods.name: doCopyRequirements
methods.description: Performs the copying of multiple requirements to another specification.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Prepares GUI data to copy a requirement specification.

methods.name: doCopy
methods.description: Handles the actual copying of a requirement specification.

methods.name: doFreeze
methods.description: Freezes a requirement specification and its child nodes, including requirements and revisions.

methods.name: simpleCompare
methods.description: Compares two requirement spec versions and indicates if a force or suggested revision is needed.

methods.name: doCreateRevision
methods.description: Creates a new revision of a requirement specification.

methods.name: process_revision
methods.description: Processes the revision, including validation, saving, or prompting for user input.

methods.name: fileUpload
methods.description: Handles file uploads related to requirement specifications.

methods.name: deleteFile
methods.description: Deletes an uploaded file associated with a requirement specification.

methods.name: initGuiObjForAttachmentOperations
methods.description: Initializes the GUI object state for attachment operations.

methods.name: bulkReqMon
methods.description: Prepares GUI data for bulk monitoring of requirements.

methods.name: doBulkReqMon
methods.description: Performs bulk start/stop/toggle monitoring operations on requirements.
